name: basketball-pov
description: 2K-style behind-the-player POV breakdowns (three.js, rendered headless to MP4): v2 is a 1v1 vs a square defender driven by real motion capture.

scripts.render: node tools/events2.mjs && python3 tools/audio.py out/events2.json out/audio2.wav && node tools/render.mjs --page src/index2.html --out out/1v1_pov_silent.mp4 --workers 3 && bash tools/mux.sh out/1v1_pov_silent.mp4 out/audio2.wav out/1v1_pov.mp4
scripts.render:v1: node tools/events.mjs && python3 tools/audio.py && node tools/render.mjs --out out/ball_screen_pov_silent.mp4 --workers 3 && bash tools/mux.sh
